labels.title: Print labels

kindHints.pair: Spine band on top and barcode label below, one pair per book (the current printout).
kindHints.barcode: Only the internal barcode label, for reprints.
kindHints.spine: Only the spine band, for example after a reclassification.

labels.startHint: From 1 to {{max}}: skips the labels already used on the sheet.

labels.pendingCount: {{count}} {{count:plural; one:copy; other:copies;}} with labels to print
labels.afterPrint: The print page opened in a new tab. Once the labels are printed, mark them as printed.

cards.title: Print cards
cards.afterPrint: The print page opened in a new tab. Once the cards are printed, mark them as printed.

layouts.side-by-side: Front and back side by side
layouts.duplex: On both sides of the sheet

duplex.long-edge: choose “Two-sided”, flipping on the long edge;
duplex.short-edge: choose “Two-sided”, flipping on the short edge;

side-by-side.marks: Then cut out each card by joining the crop marks around the cards with a ruler, and fold it in half on the short edge.
side-by-side.line: Then cut out each card along the coloured line around it, and fold it in half on the short edge.
side-by-side.edge: Then cut out each card along its edge, and fold it in half on the short edge.

duplex.marks: Then cut out the cards by joining the crop marks around the fronts with a ruler: the back is behind the front already (ten per sheet).
duplex.line: Then cut out the cards along the coloured line around the fronts: the back is behind the front already (ten per sheet).
duplex.edge: Then cut out the cards along the edge of the fronts: the back is behind the front already (ten per sheet).
